page.content:
Late romance of Prospero, Miranda, Ariel, and an island storm.

How The Tempest connects

  • Character: Prospero — Prospero is the magician-duke of The Tempest.
  • Creator: William Shakespeare — William Shakespeare wrote The Tempest.
  • Work: First Folio — The First Folio is the first printing of The Tempest.
  • Character: Ariel — Ariel is the spirit who serves Prospero in The Tempest.
  • Location: Blackfriars Theatre — The Tempest suits the candlelit indoor stage at Blackfriars.

What is The Tempest?

The Tempest is the island play: Prospero raises a storm, rules by book and spirit, frees Ariel, and breaks his staff in a plot many readers take as Shakespeare's farewell to the stage.

Key threads lead to Prospero, William Shakespeare, First Folio, Ariel and Blackfriars Theatre.
